breakdown.description: The prompt treats the internal torque as uniform over the whole shaft, even though applied torques at intermediate locations make the internal torque piecewise constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly removes the incorrect 'single internal torque over full length' idea and requires segment-by-segment analysis, with separate internal torque determination for 0→400 mm and 400→1200 mm, matching the ground truth’s piecewise treatment.
